Actually, yes that is a planned feature. I wrote the Arcane Library Card
Inventory© tool that accompanies my deck builder as a first pass at the
inventory functions. I think that ultimately I want a reporting tool
that will look at my collection, and the decks that I currently have
constructed and tell me if I have enough cards (e.g., Immortal Grapple)
to make a new deck.

If you have any more ideas, please let me know.

David

> Daliyah's capacity is 4.

Scott is correct, as usual. I originally compiled the database from the
"official" card lists maintained at WoTC. We have found that they are
imcomplete and inaccurate to the extreme. Each release of the deck
builder has updated the database with more corrections. I intend to
release accurate card lists as soon as all of the database errors have
been found.

Thanks,

David
